subject: Mathematics

source.topic: Numbers, operations and relationships: Counting (integrated with number patterns and mental maths)
source.subtopic: Count forwards and backwards in 10s, 5s, 2s, 3s and 4s within the same ranges, and in 20s, 25s, 50s and 100s to at least 1000

show.line: Big jumps! Count in fifties. Fifty, one hundred, one hundred and fifty, two hundred. Count in hundreds to one thousand!

rounds.prompt: Count in fifties. 100, 150, 200. What comes next?
Count in hundreds. 600, 700, 800. What comes next?
Count in twenty fives. 25, 50, 75. What comes next?
rounds.praise: Yes! One hundred. Four twenty fives.

rounds.prompt: Count in twenties. Twenty, forty, sixty, then what? Say the number.
Count back in hundreds. 1000, 900, 800. What comes next?
Count the money in fifty rand notes. How many rand?
Count in fifties. 850, 900, 950. What comes next?

hints: Say the jumps out loud. Fifty, one hundred, one hundred and fifty.
Two twenty fives make fifty. Two fifties make one hundred.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! Count in twenty fives. 25, 50, 75.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! The jump is twenty five, not ten. 75 and 25 is 100.

parent_line: Can count in twenties, twenty fives, fifties and hundreds to 1000.
